Apple is preparing to launch its latest flagship phones, the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Ultra, continuing the company's long-standing tradition of new product releases. Below are our predictions for the iPhone 18 Pro announcement and release dates, along with related details about this product line.

The iPhone 18 Pro announcement will take place in September, but there is one detail worth noting.

The iPhone is Apple's most important product, accounting for the largest share of the company's revenue. One of the ways Apple keeps the iPhone business thriving is by releasing a new flagship model every year.

For years, these new iPhone models have been announced in September, and all signs point to the same timeline being followed this year.

Here are the dates of the three most recent iPhone announcements:

  • 2025: September 9 (Tuesday)
  • 2024: September 9 (Monday)
  • 2023: September 12 (Tuesday)

As can be seen, Apple's iPhone announcement schedule is extremely consistent, with the main flagship models typically debuting around the second week of September.

The variable this year is that Labor Day falls unusually late on September 7. Apple is unlikely to invite the media to an event on a U.S. federal holiday, so September 8 can essentially be ruled out.

That means the earliest possible announcement date is September 9 (Wednesday).

September 9 aligns with the date from the past two years and is also consistent with what Apple did in 2022, when the new iPhones debuted two days after Labor Day.

If September 9 ultimately doesn't work out, the latest expected announcement date would be pushed back to the beginning of the following week.

In any case, the iPhone 18 Pro will officially debut in early-to-mid September.

However, a major change is expected this year: the standard iPhone 18 won't go on sale until early 2027. According to reports, Apple's fall flagship lineup this year will only include the following three models:

iPhone 18 Pro Expected Release Date

Although the exact date of Apple's iPhone announcement may shift slightly due to Labor Day, the release schedule following the announcement is fairly consistent: new phones typically go on sale the Friday of the announcement week.

Therefore, if the iPhone 18 Pro debuts on September 9 (Wednesday), pre-orders will open on September 11 (or be pushed back to Saturday, September 12, to avoid clashing with the 9/11 anniversary), and the new phones will officially reach users on Friday, September 18.

A look back at Apple's recent iPhone announcement history is enough to confirm this pattern.

2025: iPhone 17

  • Announcement date: September 9 (Tuesday)
  • Pre-order date: September 12 (Friday)
  • Release date: September 19 (Friday)

2024: iPhone 16

  • Announcement date: September 9 (Monday)
  • Pre-order date: September 13 (Friday)
  • Release date: September 20 (Friday)

2023: iPhone 15

  • Announcement date: September 12 (Tuesday)
  • Pre-order date: September 15 (Friday)
  • Release date: September 22 (Friday)

Unless Apple breaks with its usual practice this year, September 18 will be the day users can get their hands on the iPhone 18 Pro.

iPhone 18 Pro Release Date: Summary

In summary, based on Apple's past patterns, here are our predictions for the announcement and release dates of the iPhone 18 series.

2026: iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, iPhone Ultra

  • Announcement date: September 9 (Wednesday)
  • Pre-order date: September 11 (Friday) or September 12 (Saturday)
  • Release date: September 18 (Friday)

The iPhone Ultra may launch slightly later than the iPhone 18 Pro, but there is no confirmed information at this time.

Which new iPhone 18 model are you planning to buy? Let us know in the comments.
